**LINEAR REGERESSION**

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

```

```{r}
data("cars") 
print(cars)

```

Creating a Linear Model

```{r}
cars %>% 
  lm(dist~speed,data=.) %>% 
  summary()

```

Alternatively

```{r}
mod <- cars %>% 
  lm(dist~speed,data=.)
```

To get the attributes of the object mod

```{r}
attributes(mod)
```

Now plotting the residuals of the mod in a histogram

```{r}
hist(data=mod,x=mod$residuals,color="blue",fill="grey")

```

To use the model to predict various speeds

```{r}
new_speeds <- data.frame(speed=c(10,15,20)) %>% 
  print()
```

Now predicting the new observations

```{r}
predict(mod,new_speeds) %>%
  round(2)
```

Plotting the linear model graph

```{r}
ggplot(data=cars,aes(x=cars$speed,y=cars$dist))+
  geom_point(color="yellow")+
  geom_abline()
  theme_bw()
```
